Location: Comrade Commander! Come quickly, we must act swiftly.  Let me introduce you. I am the political commissar attached to your command.  The capitalist swine's are close to crushing our glorious revolution!  The Great War is over but the war for communism is still in its early phase.  We have overthrown the Tsar but that has not stopped the capitalists, monarchists and other enemies of the people to unite, raise forces and march on our people's republic!  Petrograd lies under attack and Siberia is under enemy control.   Now from the Ukraine a certain traitor named Denikin is directing his army towards our capital of Moscow!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
VORONEZH (22 OCTOBER 1919)

Comrade Commander! Come quickly, we must act swiftly.  Let me introduce you. I am the political commissar attached to your command.  The capitalist swine's are close to crushing our glorious revolution!  The Great War is over but the war for communism is still in its early phase.  We have overthrown the Tsar but that has not stopped the capitalists, monarchists and other enemies of the people to unite, raise forces and march on our people's republic!  Petrograd lies under attack and Siberia is under enemy control.   Now from the Ukraine a certain traitor named Denikin is directing his army towards our capital of Moscow!

But we are not defeated yet!  While the White armies of Denikin march north, their front becomes wider and wider.  Our Eight Army has just now lost the city of Voronezh at the Don River.  However the army is still intact and resumes fighting.  Reinforcements from Moscow are on their way as we speak!  Your newly formed command of the First Cavalry Army has been ordered to move out and attack Voronezh from the west.  Indeed comrade, you will be cutting through their flank like a knife through butter! 

Do not stop for nothing.  Go for your objectives.  Make terror your weapon!  Liberate the peasants of Voronezh!

Location: I bring good news from Moscow, comrade!  The leaders are very happy with your progress.  The fear of a successful army full of horse warriors is excellent propaganda material.  Yet it is not only propaganda!  Your army has not been defeated and is close to dealing another crucial blow to the capitalist's cause in southern Russia!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
ROSTOV (6 January 1920)

I bring good news from Moscow, comrade!  The leaders are very happy with your progress.  The fear of a successful army full of horse warriors is excellent propaganda material.  Yet it is not only propaganda!  Your army has not been defeated and is close to dealing another crucial blow to the capitalist's cause in southern Russia!

The momentum still lies with our cause!  The capitalist armies are ever retreating further  south.  Your Army has the opportunity to capture the important communication center of Rostov.  If we control Rostov the Caucasus will also fall into our hands!

Again, comrade, do not watch your back. Only go for Rostov and do not let your troops be stopped by road blocks or anything else important. It is vital that we capture Rostov before the capitalist swines have the time to reinforce the city!

Location: Comrade, finally all of your command has arrived at the new front in the west.  The front against the Poles!  The newly emerged Polish state has invaded our sacred territory both in the Belarus as here in the Ukraine.  Kiev has fallen into Polish hands already but again the enemy is widespread and this offers chances to turn the tide!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
BATTLE OF VOLODARKA (29 May 1920)

Comrade, finally all of your command has arrived at the new front in the west.  The front against the Poles!  The newly emerged Polish state has invaded our sacred territory both in the Belarus as here in the Ukraine.  Kiev has fallen into Polish hands already but again the enemy is widespread and this offers chances to turn the tide!

Your force will assemble south of Kiev and attack the Polish positions well south of Kiev.  Your goal will be to force a way through the Polish line and open up a gap so we can pour in infantry and cut off the enemy at Kiev.  Your operation will be supported by the 3rd Don Cossack Brigade which is few days march behind you.

Location: The Revolution is on its way to the West!  Comrade, a major offensive by our armies north and south of Kiev has pushed back the Polish bandits.  Even blind people can see that Kiev is about to fall.  Or better said, given back to the people of Kiev!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
KIEV COUNTEROFFENSIVE (9 June 1920)

The Revolution is on its way to the West!  Comrade, a major offensive by our armies north and south of Kiev has pushed back the Polish bandits.  Even blind people can see that Kiev is about to fall.  Or better said, given back to the people of Kiev!

Your Cavalry Army has taken part of the push south of Kiev and is now in excellent position to cut off the capitalist's troops still in Kiev.  The Twelfth Army is approaching Kiev from the east.  The Polish criminals have no respect for the property of the Kiev people and are likely to demolish the bridges and perhaps even more!  You are ordered to liberate Kiev, and join up with Twelfth Army and advance as far as you can to the west!

Location: No, comrade, you do have to worry about your food supply.  Take anything from the country as you go.  The people will help you and if they do not it is because they are still terrified of repressions by the capitalist pigs.  Now let us go back to our plan of operations, comrade.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
DELAY AT ROVNO (1 July 1920)

No, comrade, you do have to worry about your food supply.  Take anything from the country as you go.  The people will help you and if they do not it is because they are still terrified of repressions by the capitalist pigs.  Now let us go back to our plan of operations, comrade. 

After our success at Kiev, the entire front in the Ukraine is moving west.  And still is! The Polish armies are far from defeated but they lack the power to stop our people's army for once and for all.  While our strategic goal will be Lwow, or Lemberg as the old imperialists from Germany would name it.  However the Poles seem to everything to stop them from liberating the people they are oppressing!

You are near Rovno.  As always you know what to do.  Capture all vital communication centers and push as far west as possible.  Most of all let nothing stop you!  Like a tornado you must use your mobility.  After all it is the symbol for cavalry!

Location: The war is going excellently!  The Revolution will soon liberate the rest of Europe and join with other communists all over the continent!  But first we must concentrate on capturing Warsaw in the north and Lwow here in the south!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
BATTLE OF BRODY (29 July 1920)

The war is going excellently!  The Revolution will soon liberate the rest of Europe and join with other communists all over the continent!  But first we must concentrate on capturing Warsaw in the north and Lwow here in the south!

Yesterday your forces captured the town of Brody.  Your pursuit of the Polish Army has left them shattered and desperately awaiting reserves.  Let them tremble under the hooves of your horses!

Location: Comrade, let me quote something for the French socialist newspaper "L'Humanite" from early August.  "Not a man, not a soul, not a shell for reactionary and capitalist Poland. Long live the Russian Revolution!  Long live the Workmen's International!"  As you can see our struggle against the capitalists is not going unnoticed.  The eyes of the socialists all over the world are upon us!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
BATTLE OF ZADWORZE (17 August 1920)

Comrade, let me quote something for the French socialist newspaper "L'Humanite" from early August.  "Not a man, not a soul, not a shell for reactionary and capitalist Poland. Long live the Russian Revolution!  Long live the Workmen's International!"  As you can see our struggle against the capitalists is not going unnoticed.  The eyes of the socialists all over the world are upon us!

Now back to the battle situation, comrade!  There will be time for rejoicing after our victory is certain!  I know I have been saying this for days but Lwow is now really within our grasp.  We stand some 50 kilometers from Lwow and it appears that there is little between us and the city.  However we cannot take a city, always a very hostile terrain for cavalry, without infantry support and better supply.  Hence, it is vital that we capture the railroad junction of Zadworze.  What the capitalists can gather to resist, I cannot tell. What I can tell is that within days we will be marching into Lwow!

Location: Comrade there lays the old city of Lwow.  It was the goal of the Tsar in 1914, Brusilov in 1916 and our goal in 1920.  The goal of the Revolution!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
LWOW (20 August 1920)

Comrade there lays the old city of Lwow.  It was the goal of the Tsar in 1914, Brusilov in 1916 and our goal in 1920.  The goal of the Revolution!

Our Red Army is closing in on the city from the north and east.  Do I have to tell you about the instructions from Moscow?  They are expecting the Red Flag of the Revolution in Lwow as soon as possible!  Divisions of our Fourteenth Army are closely following your cavalry.  Polish resistance is unknown although interrogations have reported that the Poles bought time at Zadworze for defensive and offensive operations.  I believe these are capitalistic and criminal lies imprinted on the Polish soldiers.

Go, comrade, liberate Lwow!!!

Location: I have some bad news, comrade.  A few days ago while you were busy trying to capture Lwow; the Polish imperialists started a counteroffensive pushing through the center of the line between Lwow and Warsaw.  After their breakthrough they turned north and now the entire northern command is retreating in order not to be encircled!  Our dreams of capturing Warsaw have to be shelved!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
BATTLE OF KOMAROW (29 August 1920)

I have some bad news, comrade.  A few days ago while you were busy trying to capture Lwow; the Polish imperialists started a counteroffensive pushing through the center of the line between Lwow and Warsaw.  After their breakthrough they turned north and now the entire northern command is retreating in order not to be encircled!  Our dreams of capturing Warsaw have to be shelved!

Your cavalry is needed north!  If you sweep northwards and cut into the right flank of the Polish offensive we might again turn the tide and Poland will be liberated from their reactionary capitalists!

The Poles have been able to form some kind of defensive line while you were pulling back from the Lwow operation.  However, this is no reason to be worried.  I am talking about the Cavalry Army!  It has not been defeated for months and just saying the name strikes terror into the enemy!  Strike north, and join up with our people's army in the north!!!

Location: Comrade have I ever told you why I joined the Bolshevik party?  No, but you are right. There is no time for such tales.  I have noticed it, comrade.  Morale is low among the ranks.  The sudden change in the course of the war has left its traces.  This is a serious set back.  But it is merely a set back!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
RETREAT FROM ROVNO (18 September 1920)

Comrade have I ever told you why I joined the Bolshevik party?  No, but you are right. There is no time for such tales.  I have noticed it, comrade.  Morale is low among the ranks.  The sudden change in the course of the war has left its traces.  This is a serious set back.  But it is merely a set back!

The Northern armies will have to retreat on their own to defensive positions while we prepare to strike again and then finally make the wishes of millions of proletarians come true!  In the south it has been quieter but it seems the imperialists in Warsaw have gathered enough men to continue the counteroffensive in the south as well.

There is no hope of stopping the monarchists now but we will not fall into enemy hands. We will retreat, reorganize and make the Polish capitalists pay for this!  The Revolution will not be tamed!  Make your way east, comrade, the town of Rovno has fallen into the dirty hands of the enemy!  Retreat!

Location: That traitor Wrangel still operates like a wolf from the Crimea.  He stabbed the people's army in the back while we were occupied with the war against Poland.  Now that those reactionaries have seen that the Revolution in Russia cannot be stopped, we can muster all resources to bring peace to Russia!  Russia ruled by its people!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
KAKHOVKA (20 October 1920)

That traitor Wrangel still operates like a wolf from the Crimea.  He stabbed the people's army in the back while we were occupied with the war against Poland.  Now that those reactionaries have seen that the Revolution in Russia cannot be stopped, we can muster all resources to bring peace to Russia!  Russia ruled by its people!

Wrangel has broken out of the Crimea some time ago and captured land north of the Perekop isthmus.  We can only be grateful for a foolish act like that.  His forces are now strung out and have few reserves.  The idiots aligning themselves with Wrangel's fate must now even face the Cavalry Army!

Comrade, cross the Dnjepr River near Kakhovka and quickly penetrate through the enemy lines.  Their force must not reach the Perekop isthmus before we do if we are to gain an easy victory!  The proletariat has suffered enough during the last years!

Location: Quickly, comrade.  We have almost made it to the Perekop isthmus.  If those Tsarists are willing to make a stand against the glorious people of Russia then they will do it there!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
PEREKOP (28 October 1920)

Quickly, comrade.  We have almost made it to the Perekop isthmus.  If those Tsarists are willing to make a stand against the glorious people of Russia then they will do it there!

While other armies are mopping up enemy criminals that have been encircled, all of the remaining people's army not occupied with that task is being directed to the Perekop isthmus. They will be placed under your command as soon as they arrive in the region, comrade! In Moscow they regard you as a military genius!  The Revolution is driving the proletariat to great acts!

Your horses are the most mobile force that we have, comrade.  Dash to the isthmus and force your way into the Crimea!!!

Location: It all does not matter anymore, comrade.  Strategy?  We want victory!  The Tsarist monarchists know their fate.  Their dream of a Russia full of slaves they can control is gone!  The people have stood up against this injustice and united itself to drive out the capitalist oppressors!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
SEVASTOPOL (11 November 1920)

It all does not matter anymore, comrade.  Strategy?  We want victory!  The Tsarist monarchists know their fate.  Their dream of a Russia full of slaves they can control is gone!  The people have stood up against this injustice and united itself to drive out the capitalist oppressors!

There are clear signs that the capitalists from London will send the Royal Navy to Russia and attempt to evacuate Wrangel and his forces.  Comrade, this shows the lies told by the British and Wrangel.  How are they to evacuate a massive army?  Most likely they will only bring him and a few others to safety while the rest await the mercy of the glorious people's army!

Now, go forward and hunt down the criminals of the people of Russia before they can get away!

Location: Welcome, Herr General. You are facing the 6. Japanese army. The Japanese have passed the Chalchin Gol. Your mission is to put the enemy over the river.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle at the Chalchin Gol
Welcome, Herr General. You are facing the 6. Japanese army. The Japanese have passed the Chalchin Gol. Your mission is to put the enemy over the river.
Your troops:
We have chosen some troops for you. You will have six different troops, each of them is of another class. And you are able to order more units in a recent scale.  Keep in mind that your decision can be important in coming battles.
Enemy troops: 
The 6. Japanese army have only a few tanks and very few air support. The Japanese are worn out. They have no rail connection, so they are certainly not able to relieve their troops.
Sgn Major Heinz

Location: You surely know, that we are at war with Finland at the moment. Your mission is to break through the finish lines at Suomussalmi.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of Suomussalmi
You surely know, that we are at war with Finland at the moment. Your mission is to break through the finish lines at Suomussalmi. 
Your troops:
You have to solve this mission only with little help from auxiliary troops. 
Enemy troops: 
The Finish have only a few troops. Mainly infantry troops are awaiting you on your way to Suomussalmi.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Comrade General, you surely know that the Germans have assaulted our country. Now, the situation is really delicate. While we are speaking, every moment German troops can fulfill the closing of the Minsker pocket. The Panzergruppe 2 and 3 have bypassed Minsk in the northern and southern and every moment they can team up near of Borissow to close the pocket. You have the permission to evacuate the pocket in need. But you should try to hold Minsk, the Minsker Airfield and Borissow as long as possible.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Pocket of Minsk:
Comrade General, you surely know that the Germans have assaulted our country. Now, the situation is really delicate. While we are speaking, every moment German troops can fulfill the closing of the Minsker pocket. The Panzergruppe 2 and 3 have bypassed Minsk in the northern and southern and every moment they can team up near of Borissow to close the pocket. You have the permission to evacuate the pocket in need. But you should try to hold Minsk, the Minsker Airfield and Borissow as long as possible. 
Your troops:
You will get help from the soviet Westfront. These troops have only few tank divisions but many artilleries and especially infantry divisions.
 Enemy troops:
You are facing a large part of the Heeresgruppe Mitte. The Germans have contracted a lot of tanks, infantry, artillery, 8.8 PAK and bombers west of Minsk. Hoths Panzergruppe 3 is attacking from the north, Panzergruppe 2 under Guderian is attacking from the south. You will have contact with these troops soon, too. 
Attention! Trying to hold Minsk can be really hard. The Germans are much more experienced then you. If you are a bad player you can evacuate Minsk and trying to hold Borissow and expect the enemy in the outback
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The Germans and their allies, the Rumanians, attacking Bessarabia. Stop the advance of the axis troops.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Defense of Kishinev
The Germans and their allies, the Rumanians, attacking Bessarabia. Stop the advance of the axis troops.
Your troops:
You have only your core troops. We cannot provide more troops, because they are all needed on other frontlines.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the 11. German army in the north. Some parts of the Rumanian third and fourth army are attacking from southwest. The Rumanians are inexperienced. It could be a good idea, that you use your inexperienced troops against them.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The Rumanian 4. Army has launched its attack on Odessa in the last days. They succeeded in pushing our troops back. Your mission is to launch a counterattack and put the Rumanians back to their starting position.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of Odessa:
The Rumanian 4. Army has launched its attack on Odessa in the last days. They succeeded in pushing our troops back. Your mission is to launch a counterattack and put the Rumanians back to their starting position.
Your troops:
Again, you will nearly have your own troops to deal with your mission.
Enemy troops:
The Rumanian 4. Army is inexperienced. They have only a few tanks, but a lot of cavalry and infantry. We expect that some German troops will arrive in a few days to support the Rumanian attack.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Herr General, the situation is very awkward. Your troops are threatened by encirclement. Western of Kiev, the 6. Army is attacking your positions. From the north the Panzergruppe 2 will show up every moment in the back of your positions and they will join with the advance guard of the 17. Army. Hold Kiev and the surrounding regions as long as possible, so that we have the possibility to bind German troops.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Pocket of Kiev
Herr General, the situation is very awkward. Your troops are threatened by encirclement. Western of Kiev, the 6. Army is attacking your positions. From the north the Panzergruppe 2 will show up every moment in the back of your positions and they will join with the advance guard of the 17. Army. Hold Kiev and the surrounding regions as long as possible, so that we have the possibility to bind German troops.
Your troops:
Parts of the 37. Army are subordinate to your authority. These troops are wet behind the ears and do not have much tanks, but some artillery with big caliber.
Enemy troops:
The Germans proceed in the west with many tanks and infantry. The Panzergruppe 2 and the advance guard of the 17. Army are completely motorized and have mainly Panzer II and Panzer III tanks.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The situation at the Brjansker front is very grave. The XXIV. Motorized Army Corps could brake through your lines south of Brjansk. It may be expected that they will turn northwards and try to encircle your troops. Try to evacuate your troops slowly but do not miss to defend Brjansk and your other targets.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Pocket of Brjansk
The situation at the Brjansker front is very grave. The XXIV. Motorized Army Corps could brake through your lines south of Brjansk. It may be expected that they will turn northwards and try to encircle your troops. Try to evacuate your troops slowly but do not miss to defend Brjansk and your other targets.
Your troops:
The 50. Army is reported to you. Altogether 50 troops will help you. They are still inexperienced, but they should be strong enough to slow the German advance a little bit. 
Enemy troops:
The Germans have many tank divisions, infantry divisions and bomber squadrons. You should calculate with heavy attacks from the west and the south. The strongest German troops are deployed in the southwest. 
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Now it is time to take the initiative. You are facing the 2. Panzerarmee, which will attack every moment your lines south of Tula. Hold Tula and try to realize a counterattack if possible.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Tula Counterattack
Now it is time to take the initiative. You are facing the 2. Panzerarmee, which will attack every moment your lines south of Tula. Hold Tula and try to realize a counterattack if possible.
Your troops:
You have the command about the 49. and 50. Army. The troops are still inexperienced, but they were reinforced only just. 
We are pleased to tell you, that we have decided to add a new recon unit to your troops.
Enemy troops:
Parts of the 2. Panzerarmee are under the required strength. There are not so much tanks and anti-tanks on the first front line, however the 2. Panzerarmee still have some tank divisions in reserve. Probably the Germans will march them off.
Please notice:
A brilliant victory, a normal victory and a tactical victory will lead to different scenarios. There will be no choice scenario. You should make a save game, if you want to play all scenarios.
A brilliant victory will give you the opportunity to end the war in the early 1942 by encircling the Heeresgruppe Mitte at Krasny Bor.
A normal victory will lead you to the normal progression of the campaign. 
If you achieve only a tactical victory or a loss you have to defend Moskau first, before you can continue with the normal campaign path (Demyansk).
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: After your success at Tula we could also break through the German lines north of Moscow. You are now in the near of Smolensk. The Germans had not tried to escape. I believe they have the order to stay in the pocket. Your troops should now deploy northeast and southeast of the city and attacking the last German troops which hold the last position, in which German troops could escape. Close the pocket! Hold in any case the connection to the troops east of you (both victory hexes), so the Germans could not escape. Otherwise there is a risk that your troops will be encircled.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Closing the pocket
After your success at Tula we could also break through the German lines north of Moscow. You are now in the near of Smolensk. The Germans had not tried to escape. I believe they have the order to stay in the pocket. Your troops should now deploy northeast and southeast of the city and attacking the last German troops which hold the last position, in which German troops could escape. Close the pocket! Hold in any case the connection to the troops east of you (both victory hexes), so the Germans could not escape. Otherwise there is a risk that your troops will be encircled. 
Your troops:
We can provide only a few troops for your mission, because most of the soviet armies are needed to hold the pocket closed.
Enemy troops:
The Germans have left the city and have taken positions east of the town. The Germans in this area are really weak. However, the area of the bottleneck is surrounded with mine field and other blockings. We have reliable information that the Germans do big troop movements. They have removed troops from the Heeresgruppe Süd and Heeresgruppe Nord to relieve the pocket. Moreover, troops in the pocket try to meet these troops halfway. Be fast, because the enemy is outnumbered.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: This is our last opportunity. The Germans have advanced to the western periphery of Moscow. Hold Moscow at any costs!
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Urban Warfare in Moscow
This is our last opportunity. The Germans have advanced to the western periphery of Moscow. Hold Moscow at any costs!
Your troops:
You have we command over a tank division, the Moscow garrison and several bunkers and pillboxes. We have tried to mine the way for the German divisions but we could not finish this.
Enemy troops:
You are facing several tanks and infantry divisions. Moreover, you should calculate with heavy attacks from the German Luftwaffe.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Comrade General, I have an easy mission for you. Since our offensive in the winter we could encircle the X. Army Corps near of Demyansk. Now we know that the Kampfgruppe Seydlitz is on her way to save the troops in the pocket. Stop the attack of Kampfgruppe Seydlitz and hold the pocket closen.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Destroying the Demyansk Pocket
Comrade General, I have an easy mission for you. Since our offensive in the winter we could encircle the X. Army Corps near of Demyansk. Now we know that the Kampfgruppe Seydlitz is on her way to save the troops in the pocket. Stop the attack of Kampfgruppe Seydlitz and hold the pocket closen.
Your troops:
For this easy mission you will nearly only have your tank army. The deploy-hexes around the pocket are limited.
Enemy troops:
The X. Army corps has lost strength in the battles and have only a few divisions now. Kampfgruppe Seydlitz has an equal strength, but this troops are more dangerous. Do not miss to cut the Kampfgruppe Seydlitz off from the battlefield. They should arrive on our western flank in two days. Be aware of the German Luftwaffe. We have information that several bomber squadrons are in the combat area.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: After our successes in the winter the Germans seems to have their troops reinforced. With their Hungarian allies they are starting a big offensive with the target Voronezh. Slow down the advance of the Germans, so we have enough time to prepare new positions.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Defense of Voronezh
After our successes in the winter the Germans seems to have their troops reinforced. With their Hungarian allies they are starting a big offensive with the target Voronezh. Slow down the advance of the Germans, so we have enough time to prepare new positions. 
Your troops:
You have command over the 40. and 13. Army. These troops are equipped with very new prototypes of SU tank destroyers. They could be useful for you.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the 4. Panzerarmee and the 2. Army. Moreover, in the south the 2. Hungarian Army supports them. The Hungarians are not so experienced like the Germans. The Germans have also new assault guns with higher range than our tanks. Be aware of them! Oh, wait, we have just this moment obtained the information that the Germans have marched off more troops with good tanks and tank destroyers. They will arrive in the south of the battlefield in several days.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: After our offensive in the winter there is still the German salient at Rzhew. We have decided to start a great attack on the salient with the target of destroying the defendsing German troops. Your troops should attack in the north at Rzhew, in the south at Sychewka and in the middle of the salient, break through the lines and destroy or capture the most forces.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Rzhew Meat Grinder
After our offensive in the winter there is still the German salient at Rzhew. We have decided to start a great attack on the salient with the target of destroying the defendsing German troops. Your troops should attack in the north at Rzhew, in the south at Sychewka and in the middle of the salient, break through the lines and destroy or capture the most forces.
Your troops:
You will have the command over the 30. Army. The Germans hold the only airfield in this area, but the 30. Army has a very experienced engineer troop, which has many experience in buliding airfields.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the 9. German Army. The troops in the salient are still very strong. They have built a coherent front line and break through it could be very difficult but they have no reserves after the first front line. The area is also full of landmines and fortifications. Rzhew`s defenders are very powerfull, you may need a lot of higher range artillery to break through the lines at Rzhew. Be aware, that the reserve troops are deployed in Sychewka. There you have to calculate with heavy resistance, too.
Please notice:
You will gain 100 pp per turn.This money is for refits and you will be over the cap if you do not use it, so feel free to use it.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Be ready for Operation Uranus. Today our great offensive starts with the aim to encircling the 6. Army in Stalingrad. Your troops will attack from the south and the northwest the German and their allied troops.
Countries: Germany vs Hungary vs Italy vs Romania
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Operation Uranus
Be ready for Operation Uranus. Today our great offensive starts with the aim to encircling the 6. Army in Stalingrad. Your troops will attack from the south and the northwest the German and their allied troops. 
Your troops:
You will have command over the 65. Army. This troops will attack the Romanian front in the northeast and will support your attack against the Italian und Hungarian troops in the southeast.
Enemy troops:
In the southwest the 4. Panzerarmee under command of Hermann Hoth is your opponent. In the north the 3. Romanian Army defends the front line. In the southeast Italian and Hungary troops hold the lines. The Romanian, Italian und Hungarian troops have under strength and are bad equipped. They have only a lit bit of ammunition. Although these troops are numerous, they should be no real opponent for your troops. The situation in the southwest looks different. The 4. Panzerarmee still has some tank divisions. There is also a tank troop equipped with the new very dangerous Tiger tank.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The fascists and their allied try to break up the pocket of Stalingrad. We could stop them at the Myschkowa. You should overrun the enemy troops and throw them back to their starting position.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle at the Myschkowa
The fascists and their allied try to break up the pocket of Stalingrad. We could stop them at the Myschkowa. You should overrun the enemy troops and throw them back to their starting position. 
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this job.
Enemy troops:
The Army Group Hoth is on the other side of the Myschkowa river. We calculate with further reinforcements in the next days. Although this troops will mostly be Italians, Romanians and Hungarians.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Herr General, the victory is within one`s reach, or maybe not. The Germans have evacuated the area of Charkow and withdraw their troops. Your army should push forward into the empty area and follow the escaping Germans. Many of our generals believe that the Germans are already beaten and the war will soon be over. But I am not so optimistic. So, be careful.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Blowed by backhand
Herr General, the victory is within one`s reach, or maybe not. The Germans have evacuated the area of Charkow and withdraw their troops. Your army should push forward into the empty area and follow the escaping Germans. Many of our generals believe that the Germans are already beaten and the war will soon be over. But I am not so optimistic. So, be careful. 
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this task.
Enemy troops:
Our recons reported nearly no enemies in the area.
Please notice:
If you can hold all VHs you will come to a choice scenario, in which you must decide which Army Group you want to face for the rest of the war. If you cannot hold all VHs you will first have to fend the German attack at Prokhorowka.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The Germans are attacking our lines at Prokhorowka. Resist all Germans attacks and lead a conterattack against Belgorod.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Prokhorowka Tank Battle
The Germans are attacking our lines at Prokhorowka. Resist all Germans attacks and lead a conterattack against Belgorod. 
Your troops: 
We knowed that the Germans we lead this offensive and we could prepare strong positions. You will have command over the 51th Tank Army. This troops are not so experienced but all refreshed to over strenght. The positions before your deployment positions are secured with landmines.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the II. SS-Panzer Corps. You have to calculate with heavy tank attacks. The German Luftwaffe will support the attack of the tanks. So you need a strong air defense and fighters. 
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: We want avoid large troop movements for our big offensives, so we have decided that an army stays in the region, whrere it is deployed. You have to come to a decision, where you want to fight. You have three options:
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Choice Scenario
We want avoid large troop movements for our big offensives, so we have decided that an army stays in the region, whrere it is deployed. You have to come to a decision, where you want to fight. You have three options:
You can fight against the Heeresgruppe North:
This is the easiest and shortest path. You will attack the Germans at Leningrad and will follow them to Courland.
You can fight against the Heeresgruppe Mitte:
This can be tough, because you will have the option to fight against west allied troops. Otherwise this path will lead you to Berlin.
You can fight against the Heeresgruppe South:
This path contains several scenarios. You will first attack the Kuban-Bridgehead and push the Germans through Romania and Hungary to Prague, where this path will end.
Please notice: After the battles in Europe two of the three paths will have an additional scenario in asia.
What is your choice?
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: More then two years ago the Germans began with their blockade of Leningrad. The pitful population of the town had to feel the pinch of hunger. We want to stop the blockade and push the Germans back. In the south and in the central sovietunion the Germans are withdrawed. I am sure they will withdraw their troops, if we will be able to lauch a great attack on the 16th Army.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Free Leningrad
More then two years ago the Germans began with their blockade of Leningrad. The pitful population of the town had to feel the pinch of hunger. We want to stop the blockade and push the Germans back. In the south and in the central sovietunion the Germans are withdrawed. I am sure they will withdraw their troops, if we will be able to lauch a great attack on the 16th Army.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission, but we have allocated two divisions with bridging engineers to your troops, because the Germans have destroyed the bridges. 
Enemy troops:
The 16th Army still have some strong troops, but the best of the Germans are fighting in the south and in the central. So the 16th Army has only a few tank divisions. Mostfull infantry divisions will be your opponent.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Due to the invasion of west allied troops in France the Germans have withdrawn many troops. Your next operation will be the attack in Karelia. Move forward and capture Viipuri.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of Viipuri
Due to the invasion of west allied troops in France the Germans have withdrawn many troops. Your next operation will be the attack in Karelia. Move forward and capture Viipuri. 
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission. 
Enemy troops:
You are facing several finish troops. However, you should expect that the Germans will help Finland with some German reinforcements. Nonetheless, the enemy troops should be no problem for you.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: After our success in Karelia we now want to free the Baltic states. Your tank army have the mission to attack the Germans in Riga and throw them out of the city.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Attack on Riga
After our success in Karelia we now want to free the Baltic states. Your tank army have the mission to attack the Germans in Riga and throw them out of the city.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission. 
Enemy troops:
The 16th army and the 18th Army defends the city. There are some serious tank divisions outside of the city. In Riga fanatic infantry divisions are deployed. They have support fire from several artillery divisions.
Please notice:
The next two scenarios will be with no-auto-refit. You will gain a lot of pp for refits. 
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: We have started several trials to elimenate the trapped Germans in Courland, but all attempts were not successful. I think your men are more suitable for this mission. Attack on the front between Liepaja and Saldus, break through the German lines and take Pavilosta.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Courland Pocket
We have started several trials to elimenate the trapped Germans in Courland, but all attempts were not successful. I think your men are more suitable for this mission. Attack on the front between Liepaja and Saldus, break through the German lines and take Pavilosta.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the 16th and 18th Army. These troops are worn out, but high experienced. They have only two serious tank troops. The way to the battlefield is blocked with Blockings, Bunkers and Mindfields.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The war in Europe is over. Now we had to keep our promise and built a second front against Japan in Asia. We could push forward and are now east of Changchun. Your troops should break through the lines of Japanese and Manchukuo troops in the east of the town and capture Changchun.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Manchurian Operation
The war in Europe is over. Now we had to keep our promise and built a second front against Japan in Asia. We could push forward and are now east of Changchun. Your troops should break through the lines of Japanese and Manchukuo troops in the east of the town and capture Changchun.
Your troops:
For this attack you will only have your tank army. We own no airfield in this area. So, you should have a can build unit for this mission in your troops.
Enemy troops: 
You are facing two armies and some Manchukuo troops. These armies are bad equipped but they have entrenched themselves in the mountains east of Changchun. To break through the lines will take time.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Now it is time for our big offensive. You will attack the German Heeresgruppe Mitte at Yelnya. The Germans are well prepared for our attack, but I am sure you will be able to break through their lines.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Smolensker Offensive
Now it is time for our big offensive. You will attack the German Heeresgruppe Mitte at Yelnya. The Germans are well prepared for our attack, but I am sure you will be able to break through their lines.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission.
Enemy troops:
The Heeresgruppe Mitte still have strong troops, but they have only few tanks. On the other side you have to calculate with strong fire of high-range artillery and the German Luftwaffe has strong bomber forces in this area. The areas behind the bridges are well prepared for your attack, but if you are breaken through the resistance will be smaller.

Location: Now the time four our great offensives is come. Several armies will join the attack in Belorussia. Your troops should take Vitebsk.  Take the town and push forward to the west.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Operation Bagration
Now the time four our great offensives is come. Several armies will join the attack in Belorussia. Your troops should take Vitebsk.  Take the town and push forward to the west.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission.
Enemy troops:
Vitebsk is secured by strong fortifications and the IX. Army Corps. Further south the VI. Army Corps hold the positions. The Germans have some good tanks and tank killers like Tiger II tanks and a division of Elefants. It could be a good idea to deploy your best troops in the south and push there forward and the rest can concentrate on Vitebsk.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Herr General, meanwhile our armies have arrived Poland. You should take Krakow, west of you which is hold by the 4th Tank Army.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of Silesia
Herr General, meanwhile our armies have arrived Poland. You should take Krakow, west of you which is hold by the 4th Tank Army.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission.
Enemy troops:
The 4th tank army has far under strength, but they have some serious Panther and Tiger II tanks. The strongest resistance should be in the Krakow city areal.
Please remember:
The next scenario (and Berlin too) will be no-auto-refit scenarios.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Your troops have arrived the Oder at Küstrin. Take Küstrin, take positions along the river and build a bridgehead over the river at Küstrin.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Fortress Küstrin
Your troops have arrived the Oder at Küstrin. Take Küstrin, take positions along the river and build a bridgehead over the river at Küstrin. 
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission.
Enemy troops:
Küstrin is hold by a garrison. Behind the Oder some strong German troops will try to prevent that you can build a bridgehead. But altogether the enemy should be no problem for your troops.
Attention please:
A brilliant victory, a normal victory and a tactical victory will lead you into different paths. 
If you win brilliant, you have to end the war with the battle in Berlin. This scenario will be no-auto-refit, too.
If you win normal the west allied have captured Berlin and you have to fight against them. In this path you have the help of German troops, which you can buy for extra pp.
If you win tactical the west allied have captured Berlin and you have to fight against them. The German armies in the east could flee into the west and will support the west allies.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: Herr General, it is time for the last battle. Your troops have taken positions along the Oder. In this scenario you have several missions.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of Berlin
Herr General, it is time for the last battle. Your troops have taken positions along the Oder. In this scenario you have several missions.
-	Take Cottbus, Schwedt and Oranienburg
-	Cross the Oder at the Seelower Heights and defeat the 9th Army
-	Encircle the rest of the 9th Army in the Pocket of Halbe 
-	Do not let the troops in the pocket flee
-	Take Berlin
-	Stop the advance of the 12th Army and take Eberswalde at the Elbe
Your troops:
The 2nd Belorussian Front will assist your attack in the south and in the north. In the north the 2nd Belorussian Front should take Schwedt and fight against the 4th Tank Army. Remember, this is the last battle. You can use the massive pp for refitting if you need it.
Enemy troops:
The 9th Army, the 12th Army and the 4th Tank Army are high-experienced but worn out troops. They have some serious tank divisions with Tiger II and Panther tanks. In the areal of Berlin unexperienced Volkssturm and Landwehr troops are also common opponents. In Berlin rests of the 9th Army, police troops and Volkssturm troops defeats the city. They are supported by Waffen SS Battle Group Mohnke.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: After some planning the general stuff has decided that we will attack the allied lines at Dessau. The allies have numerous troops at this front line, so, if we can break through their lines, the allies must withdraw their other troops.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Breakthrough at Dessau
After some planning the general stuff has decided that we will attack the allied lines at Dessau. The allies have numerous troops at this front line, so, if we can break through their lines, the allies must withdraw their other troops.
Your troops:
Besides your tank army one army will support your attack. They are deployed west of your troops.
Enemy troops:
The enemy have several tank divisions. In the air you have to calculate with high resistance, too. The USAF and RAF have several air fleets in the area of Dessau. Several level-bomber squadrons will support the ground troops.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: We could trap several armies in East Friesland. We have reliable information that the west allied plans to evacuate the troops through the harbors of Emden and Wilhelmshaven. Take Emden and Wilhelmshaven before the ships arrive and destroy most of the enemy's troops to prevent the possibilities of a counterattack.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of East Friesland
We could trap several armies in East Friesland. We have reliable information that the west allied plans to evacuate the troops through the harbors of Emden and Wilhelmshaven. Take Emden and Wilhelmshaven before the ships arrive and destroy most of the enemy's troops to prevent the possibilities of a counterattack.
Your troops: 
Besides your tank army a little army will support you. This troops could be useful for the conquer of Emden.
Enemy troops:
The trapped opponents still have several dangerous tank divisions and plenty infantry. The air force will made problems to you, especially because you will have no airfield at the beginning of the battle. The next airfield is too far away. Be sure that you have troops that can build an airport.   
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The majority of the war production for the west allied comes from the Ruhr area. If we will be able to capture the Ruhr area it will be more difficult for the allied to get supplies. Take the Ruhr area, Düsseldorf and build a bridgehead over the Rhine.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle at the Ruhr
The majority of the war production for the west allied comes from the Ruhr area. If we will be able to capture the Ruhr area it will be more difficult for the allied to get supplies. Take the Ruhr area, Düsseldorf and build a bridgehead over the Rhine.
Your troops:
Besides your tank army several divisions will support your troops. Relating to your request we have given you more Flak units for this battle.
Enemy troops:
The enemies are not numerous. In the east of the Ruhr area the west allied have built a front which is saved by blockings, landmines and barbwire. More in the south the resistance seems to be not so hard.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: In what the Germans failed once we now want to success. In the Ardennes the allied have build the last defensive line. If we can manage a breakthrough the way to Antwerpen will be free and the allied troops can no longer use the harbor of Antwerpen for reinforcements.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle in the Ardennes
In what the Germans failed once we now want to success. In the Ardennes the allied have build the last defensive line. If we can manage a breakthrough the way to Antwerpen will be free and the allied troops can no longer use the harbor of Antwerpen for reinforcements. 
Your troops:
An army will support your attack. A unit of Josef Stalin tanks will assist you, too.
Enemy troops:
The allied troops are still numerous. Beware of assaults in the woody terrain. I remind you, that Josef Stalin tanks only have a few ammunitions and they are vulnerable in this terrain.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: The victory is near. Your troops are standing in the near of Antwerpen. Your mission is to eliminate the last allied troops and occupy the harbor of Antwerpen to prevent further allied reinforcements.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Charge on Antwerpen
The victory is near. Your troops are standing in the near of Antwerpen. Your mission is to eliminate the last allied troops and occupy the harbor of Antwerpen to prevent further allied reinforcements.
Your troops:
The harbor of Antwerpen is secured by several ships. You will have command over a part of our fleet. Some bombers will assist you in this fight, too. The allied hold the only airfield in this area. It could be a good idea to build a new airfield at the start of the battle.
Enemy troops:
The defenders have abandoned the area south of Antwerpen and secured it with landmines and blockings. After this line the enemy front line is not so big. In the outback the allied still have some big tanks, like the Sherman Easy Eight type. In the harbor the allied unload unexperienced tank divisions at the moment.
Sgn. Major Heinz

We have reliable information that the Germans plans to evacuate the bridgehead preventing a cut off. We want attack before they can escape. Force an attack and destroy the German forces.
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Kuban-Bridgehead
Since many months the Germans has the bridgehead at the black sea. We could push them back, but all tries to destroy the Germans and their allied failed. We have reliable information that the Germans plans to evacuate the bridgehead preventing a cut off. We want attack before they can escape. Force an attack and destroy the German forces.
Your troops:
You will only have your tank army for this mission. The Germans control all two airfields in this area. We have provided an engineer troop to your army. It should be able to build a little airfield in a few days.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the 17th German Army. Also, there are several Romanian and Slovak troops. The Romanians and the Slovaks have only a low strength. The German troops has only a few tanks and only one fighter squadron. Maybe there will be no great fightback, but you have to be fast, too.
Sgn. Major Heinz

You only have the command about your tank army.

The Germans and Romanians have several divisions in this area. The Romanians have suffered heavy losses in the war and their troops are quite under normal strength.
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: While the Germans try to break through our lines at the Lake Balaton in the west, your mission is to break through the German and Hungarian line at Szekesfehervar. With the capture of the town the way to Vienna will be open.

While the Germans try to break through our lines at the Lake Balaton in the west, your mission is to break through the German and Hungarian line at Szekesfehervar. With the capture of the town the way to Vienna will be open.

You will only have your tank army for this mission.

Your opponent is the Army Group Balck. The troops are battle-wearied, but they have some serious tanks and fighters.

Current Description (smScenDesc):
Battle of Prague
Berlin is captured by our troops. Now we want to destroy the remaining German armies in Czechia and in Slovakia and free Prague. You have to broke through the German lines at Nagysallo and move north.
Your troops: 
The 2nd Ukrainian Front will assist your attack on the German lines. Also, some Romanian, Czech and Polish troops will be under your command. Unfortunately, there is no airfield in this area. So, you have to build one, before your planes can start.
Enemy troops:
You are facing the 8th Army. These troops have lost much of their strength but they were supplied with some serious prototypes in the last days. The Germans have some new fighters in the area, but there is no airfield in the near, so, the fighters can support the German troops only a few days.  
Sgn. Major Heinz

Location: 13 de Noviembre de 1936
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Batalla por Madrid

13 de Noviembre de 1936

Bien comandante, le pondre al corriente de la situacion presente; 4 meses despues del golpe de Julio la situacion es caotica, algunos sectores de la Peninsula y la totalidad del protectorado de Marruecos se han unido a la sublevacion. Columnas rebeldes provenientes del Norte y el Sur han alcanzado Madrid. Mientras que las columnas del general Mola se han visto detenidas en las sierras del Norte de la capital, el ejercito de Africa al mando del general Franco ha alcanzado los barrios del Sur y del Oeste de la ciudad y constituye una gravisima amenaza, no deben cruzar el rio Manzanares!. Ademas se teme que elementos quintacolumnistas aparezcan dentro de la ciudad segun se vayan acercando las columnas rebeldes.

El gobierno de la Republica ha dado la orden de la formacion de un ejercito popular del que comienzan a formarse las primeras brigadas mixtas. Ademas, contamos con la valerosa aportacion de los voluntarios extranjeros, que hemos agrupado en algunas ''Brigadas Internacionales''. Su mision consistira en dirigir esas unidades de nueva creacion y algunas milicias para defender Madrid. Si Madrid cae, de por sentado que habremos perdido la guerra.
Recuerde el lema de Madrid; No pasaran!.

Batalla por Madrid

November 13th, 1936

Well commander, please listen to me, I will explain you the present situation. 4 months after the coup de'etat of July the situation is chaotic, some peninsular areas and the whole of Spanish Morocco are supporting the uprising. Rebel columns coming from the North, and from the South have reached Madrid. While the columns from the North under the command of the General Mola have been stopped in the mountains north of Madrid, the African Army under the command of the General Franco is now approaching the South and West neighborhoods of Madrid. They are a dangerous menace, and they must not cross the Manzanares river! Also, probably ''5th column'' elements will appear with the rebel approach to Madrid.

The Republican government has finally given the order to form a People's Army, some Mixed Brigades (Brigadas Mixtas, ''BM'') are now ready, and also other International Brigades (consisting mainly of foreign anti-fascist volunteers) should be ready for the battle!

Your mission is to defend Madrid at any cost, if Madrid falls, the whole Spain will fall! Remember the Madrid people's slogan; No pasaran! ("They shall not pass!").

Location: 16 de Febrero de 1937
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Jarama Valley

16 de Febrero de 1937

La marcha rebelde sobre Madrid esta completamente detenida por el momento. En las ultimas semanas los movimientos fascistas delatan que los planes del enemigo han cambiado y ahora en lugar del asalto directo a la capital se han decantado por rodearla, primero atacando nuestro sector Sur-Este en el rio Jarama para despues enlazar con las columnas que estan mas al norte.
Por tanto, evite que el enemigo cruce el rio Jarama a cualquier precio!!!. Tampoco se olvide que el importante punto estrategico del Cerro de los Angeles no debe caer en manos rebeldes

Se han tomado un par decisiones para tratar de poner orden en el caos reinante organizando unas cuantas divisiones provisionales para el Ejercito Popular, ademas esperamos que las recientes llegadas de armamento sovietico nos sean de ayuda para acometer esta tarea.

Buena suerte.

Valle del Jarama

February 16th, 1937

The rebel march on Madrid is completely stopped for the moment. In the past weeks, the movements of the fascist have shown us that the enemy's plans have changed. Now they will try to encircle the capital, cutting our communications with Valencia (new seat of the Republican goverment). The High Command thinks that stopping the rebel plans is possible, and the best sector to do it is the Jarama river area (SE of Madrid). Provisional divisions have been formed for this duty.

Your mission is to stop the rebels here, by counterattacking, and keeping open communications with Madrid.

Buena suerte.

Location: 8 de Marzo de 1937
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Guadalajara

8 de Marzo de 1937

A primeras horas nuestros asesores sovieticos (Rodimtsev y Goriev) nos han informado de una gran concentracion de tropas en la linea Brihuega-Torija, y que se oyen a lo lejos raras canciones italianas, lo que hace indicar que el nucleo de esas tropas es el CTV italiano que capturo Malaga en fechas pasadas.

Tras el exito en el valle del Jarama nuestro objetivo ahora es asestar un duro golpe al enemigo, que tiene una confianza excesiva en sus propios medios, y hacer dudar a los rebeldes de la valia de la cooperacion que reciben de los italianos. 

Una gran victoria aqui podra poner punto y final a las aspiraciones rebeldes sobre Madrid, al menos por el momento.

Guadalajara

March 8th, 1937

Early this morning, our Soviet advisors (Rodimtsev and Goriev) informed us of a large concentration of troops spotted along the Brihuega-Torija line. Our advanced recon units have heard strange Italian songs. There is no doubt the Italian CTV which captured Malaga the past days is on the way to strike again, here in Guadalajara.

After your success in the Jarama Valley, our aim now, is to accomplish a grand victory over the overconfident Italian troops.

A decisive victory here will be the end of the rebel's menacing threat to Madrid, at least for the moment.

Location: 6 de Julio de 1937
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Ofensiva de Brunete

6 de Julio de 1937

Tras las primeras pruebas de fuego mas o menos victoriosas para el Ejercito Popular, sumado eso a los ultimos envios de armas que han llegado desde la URSS, se puede decir que estamos en posicion de lanzar nuestra primera gran ofensiva de la guerra.
El plan consiste en un ataque desde el Norte y el Este en el sector de Brunete para embolsar a las fuerzas rebeldes aqui presentes. La mayor parte del V y el XVIII cuerpos atacaran desde el Norte en direccion a Brunete y Villafranca del Castillo, mientras que desde Madrid llegara el II cuerpo por el Este en direccion a Villaviciosa de Odon. Tambien llegara la 14 Division posteriormente como refuerzo, ademas de una buena cantidad de aparatos de las FARE.

Los motivos de esta ofensiva son varios, por un lado el objetivo principal es embolsar al enemigo, pero tambien alejar a los fascistas definitivamente de Madrid y conseguir que estos retiren parte de sus tropas del frente Norte, para asi aliviar la presion ejercida sobre el mismo. Desde algunas instancias tambien se espera que esta ofensiva de lugar al final de la guerra, pero entre nosotros, creo que eso es algo complicado.

Espero que a pesar del aplastante calor reinante, sus acciones alcancen los resultados previstos. 

Ofensiva de Brunete

July 6th, 1937

After your first successful actions with the People's Army, and with our new Soviet equipment, received in the past few days, we are in a good position to launch our first big offensive of the war.

The plan consists of an attack from the North and the East on the Brunete sector, to surround the rebel forces there. The main part of the V and the XVIII Army Corps will attack from the North southwards to Brunete and Villafranca del Castillo, while the II Army Corp arrives from Madrid, taking the Villaviciosa de Odon. Also, the 14th Division will arrive as reinforcements, as well as a good number of FARE aircraft.

The High Command wants to encircle the rebel troops, create a pocket, and then destroy it. This will allow us to push the rebel lines far away from Madrid. A success here would make the rebels withdraw troops from the Austrian Front in the North, which is under horrible pressure.

Some people also believe that a major success for us here would finish the war... but personally I don't think so.

I hope that in spite of the African heat we are suffering this Summer, the People's Army will be able to achieve all the scheduled goals.

Buena Suerte.

Location: 24 de Agosto de 1937
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Ofensiva de Aragon

24 de Agosto de 1937

Bienvenido al frente de Aragon, general. Los objetivos alcanzados en el sector de Brunete no correspondieron finalmente con nuestras aspiraciones, pero la ofensiva franquista sobre el Frente Norte se ha visto afectada.
Para tratar de nuevo de frenar completamente la tremenda presion que los rebeldes ejercen sobre Asturias y Cantabria, el alto mando ha creado esta nueva operacion sobre Aragon, consistente en un ataque concentrico que caera finalmente sobre Zaragoza. En su camino hacia la capital aragonesa encontrara multitud de guarniciones falangistas bien atrincheradas que trataran de resistir hasta la llegada de refuerzos, asi que actue con rapidez. Contara tambien con la ayuda de un grupo de guerrilleros cuya mision es capturar los puentes de Zaragoza...
Tenemos mas equipo que en Brunete, asi que se esperan amplios resultados de esta operacion.

---Historicamente la operacion fue un fracaso, ya que las divisiones republicanas se vieron detenidas por las guarniciones fuertemente atrincheradas, y posteriormente la ofensiva acabaria conociendose como batalla de Belchite.

Ofensiva de Aragon

August 24th, 1937

Welcome to the Aragon front, general. The operation of Brunete did not achieve everything that we wanted. However, the enemy has withdrawn some troops from the Northern Front. In order to try again to stop the rebel offensive in Asturias and Cantabria, the High Command has planned a new operation, here in Aragon. Its purposes are twofold. First, capture the objectives. Second, draw more troops away from our weakened northern front.

This is again a coordinated attack. The goal is Aragon's capital, Zaragoza. On your way to Zaragoza, you will encounter a lot of strongly-entreched falangist garrisons. These garrisons will try to resist, and delay you, until the arrival of rebel reinforcements, so a fast advance is needed. A guerrilla group has been deployed also to capture the Zaragoza bridges, but will not be able to hold them indefinitely.

--- Historically, this operation was a minor victory for the Republicans, achieved in the battle for the small village Belchite, where the rebel reinforcements attacked the Republican left flank. This battle is known as ''Battle for Belchite'' or Batalla de Belchite in Spanish.

Location: 15 de Diciembre de 1937
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Batalla de Teruel

15 de Diciembre de 1937

A pesar de los esfuerzos realizados, las operaciones de los meses pasados no alcanzaron sus objetivos primarios, el frente Norte ha caido, y la ofensiva rebelde sobre el Levante se acerca cada vez mas a Valencia (capital de la Republica provisionalmente). Para ayudarse en su avance hacia el Mediterraneo, el enemigo cuenta con la estrategica posicion de Teruel, que capturo tiempo atras. Esta posicion constituye un enorme peligro para Levante, por lo que no podemos permitir que continue en manos rebeldes.
La ofensiva que lanzaremos consiste en otro ataque envolvente que acabara rapidamente con la guarnicion enemiga, pero de por sentado que recibiremos un duro contraataque seguidamente. Las condiciones climatologicas este invierno estan siendo especialmente duras... los -28 grados que hace ahi fuera seran un problema mas.

Buena suerte.

Batalla de Teruel

December 15th, 1937

Althought we have made valiant efforts to change the tactical and strategic situation, recent operations have not achieved the High Command's goals. The Northern front has fallen, and the rebel offensive over the Levante is approaching the Republic's provisional capital in Valencia. Now, the enemy has an important base to aid his advance on the Mediterranean Sea, Teruel. The enemy base at Teruel is a great danger for the whole Levante area. We cannot allow the enemy to continue holding Teruel, if we are to save the Republic!

The planned offensive consist of a concentrated attack on Teruel, in order to quickly finish the rebel garrison defending Teruel. The rebels are commanded by Colonel Rey D'Harcourt, a clever opponent. The High Command thinks the fascists will send a huge number of reinforcements as soon as our troops appear at Teruel, so drive your troops quickly to the objectives and be careful to secure your flanks... Reinforcements of the V Army Corps will arrive to help you.

Ah, one more thing... as you surely already know it's minus 28 degrees (-18 Fahrenheit) and the snow will be another enemy to face for El Ejercito Popular...

Buena suerte.

Location: 25 de Julio de 1938
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Ofensiva del Ebro

25 de Julio de 1938

El enemigo ha alcanzado el mar Mediterraneo y las cosas no pueden ir peor, tal vez esta sea nuestra ultima oportunidad de encauzar la situacion, general. Se ha concebido un nuevo plan de batalla, esta ocasion es el mas ambicioso de todo cuanto hemos hecho hasta ahora. Nuestro Ejercito Popular ha tomado sigilosamente posiciones en torno al rio Ebro, cerca de Amposta, en Tarragona, con la mision de cruzarlo y romper asi el frente por una zona por la que el enemigo no se lo espera.
El objetivo primario es cruzar el rio y establecer una fuerte cabeza de puente alcanzando la capital de la comarca; Gandesa. Una posible victoria en esta operacion nos permitiria futuros avances que tal vez pudiesen re-equilibrar la situacion.

Buena suerte.

Ofensiva del Ebro

July 25th, 1938

[Handwritten message received by courier]

The enemy has finally reached the Mediterranean sea, and things can't be worse. Maybe this will be our last chance to reverse the fortunes of war, commandante. A new plan has been designed. This offensive is our biggest gamble in the war up to now. People's Army units have silently taken positions along the river Ebro, nearly to the town of Amposta, in the province of Tarragona. The main mission is to cross the great Ebro river and break through the enemy lines here, in a place where an attack is not expected. Your mission is to cross the river, make a bridgehead to allow more troops to cross, and finally reach and conquer the town of Gandesa.

A victory here would allow us further advances. If we are defeated here ... No, failure is too terrible to contemplate.

Buena suerte.

Los fascistas han detenido en seco nuestra ofensiva, nos hemos quedado a las puertas de Gandesa y la aviacion Italoalemana nos hostiga continuamente. La ofensiva ha fracasado rotundamente, nuestra unica opcion ahora es retirar nuestras tropas para evitar mayores bajas.

Location: 6 de Noviembre de 1938
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Batalla del rio Segre

6 de Noviembre de 1938

El rotundo fracaso en el Ebro ha propiciado a los rebeldes lanzar una gran ofensiva sobre Catalunya. El alto mando tiene intencion de al menos detener esa ofensiva y se ha planeado una operacion en el sector de Lerida, destinada a corregir el frente y recuperar dos importantes centrales electricas al otro lado del rio.

Su mision se localizara al Norte del dispositivo, justo al Sur de Lerida, cruce el rio y alcance la localidad de Fraga, donde segun informes de agentes infiltrados se encuentra la comandancia de las tropas enemigas en este sector.

Mucho nos tememos que a pesar de todo la guerra estara perdida pase lo que pase...

Batalla del rio Segre

November 6th 1938

The disaster in the Ebro operation has allow the rebels to launch a big offensive over Catalunya. The high command wants to (at least) stop that offensive, or delay it basically. The current operation consist of an attack in the Segre river sector, Southwards to Lerida, aimed to stabilize our front and to recapture two important electric plants in the other side of the river.

Your mission is to cross the river, and take the town of Fraga, where intelligence reports the enemy command center is deployed.

However, personally I think the fate of the Republica is sealed, my friend.  If you fail, there is no one to help you.

Buena suerte.

Location: 6 de Noviembre de 1938
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Batalla del rio Segre

6 de Noviembre de 1938

Todas las cancillerias europeas estan absolutamente sorprendidas por el fulgurante cambio de rumbo que la guerra parece estar dando. Para completar la victoria se ha creado una operacion en el sector catalan al sur de Lerida, donde los rebeldes han tratado de avanzar para tratar de equilibrar la situacion. Su mision es salir al encuentro del avance fascista en el sector del rio Segre, encontrar la formacion de tropas atacantes y neutralizarla.

Agentes infiltrados informan de que el puesto de mando enemigo se encuentra en la localidad de Fraga, que constituye uno de los objetivos de la mision.

Buena suerte!, si logramos la victoria total en esta operacion la puerta hacia la capital de Aragon quedara abierta.

Batalla del rio Segre

November 6th, 1938

All the foreign goverments are absolutely amazed by the striking change of the war! To complete the victory over the rebel troops we have planned an attack along the Segre river, southwards from Lerida, where the rebels are trying to advance to halt our attacks. Your mission is to face the rebel attack on the Segre river.

Intelligence reports that the enemy command point is located in the village of Fraga, and obviously that is one of the main goals of your mission.

Buena suerte!  If we can achieve a complete victory, this operation will open the way to Zaragoza again!

Location: 12 de Febrero de 1939
Countries: Fascist forces vs France vs Italy vs Soviet Union
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Ataque a Zaragoza

12 de Febrero de 1939

Felicidades por su ascenso general!, tras el rotundo exito en la ofensiva del Ebro el enemigo se ha visto obligado a retirarse de las zonas contiguas al Mediterraneo que habia ocupado, sumado a nuestra victoria, los franceses han levantado el cierre de la frontera y las armas sovieticas que esperabamos han logrado pasar la frontera. Gracias a todo esto, es la hora de explotar nuestro exito!, ademas los aliados de los rebeldes estan perdiendo la paciencia con ellos.
Nuevamente el plan es atacar Zaragoza, aprendiendo de los errores del pasado. Zaragoza es la puerta hacia Burgos, la capital fascista. Una gran victoria aqui podria cambiar el curso de la guerra y desestabilizar toda la retaguardia enemiga, incluso incitando al levantamiento en las zonas del Norte contra los ocupantes rebeldes.

Hemos infiltrado algunos grupos de guerrilleros tras las lineas enemigas, que seguro le seran de utilidad. De paso, estos guerrilleros nos informan que los rebeldes han desplegado aqui el CTV al completo, y es probable que la 13 Division vuelva a presentar batalla... 

Esta es la batalla decisiva!!!.

Ataque a Zaragoza

February 12th, 1939

Congratulations on your promotion general! After the big success in the Ebro Offensive the enemy has retreated many troops from the Mediterranean areas. The French government has opened the border and we have received more Soviet weapons. This is the hour to start the exploiting of the present situation! Again, the plan is to attack Zaragoza, taking into account the past experiences in the Aragon front. Capturing Zaragoza will clear the path to Burgos; the Fascist capital!. A major victory here surely will change all our fortunes, and the Northern areas would rise up against the Fascists also.

Some guerrilla groups are beyond the enemy lines, and you can probably use them to our advantage. This guerrilla units have informed us that the enemy troops here are mainly composed of the complete Italian CTV and the famous rebel 13th Division.  Do not underestimate the enemy, General.

Buena suerte.

Location: 5 de Agosto de 1939
Current Description (smScenDesc):
Ceuta

5 de Agosto de 1939

La rebelion ha terminado en toda la Peninsula, la debilidad de retaguardia del enemigo ha sido clave para que el Norte se levantara contra los rebeldes, e incluso muchas unidades rebeldes se hayan cambiado de bando. Burgos, la capital enemiga ha caido, y las fuerzas insurgentes en el Sur han embarcado hacia el protectorado de Marruecos.

Para terminar la guerra debemos asaltar el protectorado. El plan consiste en atacar el puerto de Ceuta, y despues avanzar hacia Tetuan, donde se ha establecido el centro de mando de los rebeldes. Unidades navales han salido de la base de Cartagena, ademas el V cuerpo ha llegado a costas proximas a Ceuta desde Cadiz.

Algunos de nuestros valerosos guerrilleros operan ya sobre el terreno, nos han remitido informes que muestran que el enemigo cuenta con fuerzas de las que se retiraron de la Peninsula, y que ha organizado en dos divisiones, compuestas por banderas de la Legion; la division ''Ceuta'' y la division ''Tetuan'', asi como otros elementos de la ya famosa 13 Division. Los rebeldes siguen recibiendo cierta ayuda italiana, lo que complicara las cosas.

Buena suerte.

Ceuta

August 5th, 1939

The uprising against the Republic is completely smashed by our People's Army, the weakness of the rear rebel territories has been a key for our final victory, Northern places like Asturias, Santander or Euzkadi started a revolt against the rebel opressors, also, some rebel units joined the People's Army, and Burgos, the enemy capital has fallen. Many rebel troops have embarked to the Spanish Morocco, where they will try to resist with some Italian help.

To finish the war, we must clear Morocco. The high command has designed a plan, disembarking our troops in the Ceuta area and establishing two beach heads to cut the communications between Ceuta and Tetuan.

Intelligence reports the rebel forces are mainly composed by the elements from the 13th Division, and some Legion Banderas, which have been included into two newly formed divisions; the division Tetuan and the division Ceuta, which will surely be extremely hard. Also, Italian units will make harder the things.

Naval forces from the Cartagena base are also here to destroy the rebel naval power, but be careful, Italian submarines have been spotted.

Buena suerte.  Victoria or muerte!

Current Description (smScenDesc):
1918 - Sailors revolt

No one still wants war, but the government does not get it. It sends the German fleet into the final battle against the Royal Navy. Your comrades defend themselves. This means mutiny. The ships turned back. The mutineers, however, were captured ...
Your comrades need help. Karl Artelt and Lothar Popp, leader of the revolt and USPD members, stand by your side. Go in and win!! 

Note: The Steinhäuser Patrol is on the way to knock down the revolt ...

Historical:
The fleet had been moved from Kiel to Wilhelmshaven to set from there sail to the last battle. Despite utmost secrecy the plans came through to the crews.
Thereupon the sailors on three ships of the Third Naval Battle Squadron refused to weigh anchor for the last naval battle of WW1.
Part of the crew of SMS Thüringen and SMS Helgoland, two battle ships of the First Naval Battle Squadron, committed outright mutiny and sabotage. However, when a day later some torpedo boats directed their cannons onto these ships, the mutineers gave up and were led away without any resistance.
The fleet again entered Kiel. 47 sailors were arrested and detained at the naval base 'Wilhelm Souchon'.
Some 250 sailors met in the evening of 1 November in the Union House in Kiel and prevented the fleet from setting sail again. 
The Revolution started from here with the sailor Karl Artelt and shipyard worker Lothar Popp (both USPD) as ringleaders.
The next day, police closed the Union House. Several thousand sailors and workers moved to the "Großer Exerzierplatz" (large drill ground). Under the slogan: "peace and bread" they demanded the release of the mutineers.
On 4 November the governor of the naval base, Wilhelm Souchon, gave way and let the detained sailors free. However, foreign troops marched on to defeat the movement.
These were intercepted by the rebels, captured, or joined the uprising.
On the evening of 4 November's Kiel was firmly in the hands of about 40,000 rebellious sailors, soldiers and workers.

Author = Matze (M. Kessler)

Current Description (smScenDesc):
1918 Willhelmshafen

After Kiel, the naval base of Wilhelmshaven is now rebelling. Under the leadership of Bernhard Kuhnt, you are now the one representative for the Council of the 21, whom the revolution now badly needs
Conquer the north, Aurich, Emden and especially the reservists garrison Oldenburg!!!

Historically: 

In Wilhelmshaven-Rüstringen was founded on 6th November 1918, after a mass demonstration of over 20,000 naval and shipyard workers and other civilians a workers and Soldiers Council, with its executive organ, the so-called Council or the 21.
To Chairman of the Council was appointed Bernhard Kuhnt. The "21er" Council 
took over the power of the fortified towns,the North Sea Station,the encircling land of Oldenburg in Ostfriesland and all the surrounding islands, without resistance of the military station commands and declared on 10 November 1918 in front of 100,000 enthusiastic demonstrators in Wilhelmshaven,
the Socialist Republic of Oldenburg and the deposition of the Grand Duke of Oldenburg.
Under the impression of demonstrations and pressure from the large majority of Members of Parliament,Grand Duke Friedrich August of Oldenburg declared his abdication on 11 November 1918.
The Free State of Oldenburg was therefore declared in the territory of the Grand Duchy of Oldenburg.
As a provisional government was formed a Land-governing-body, to what, among others, the Rüstringer Member of Parliament Paul Hug and Kuhnt belonged.
Kuhnt became president of the new Free State of Oldenburg.
